from pathlib import Path
import sys,time,json,hashlib,os
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts');from capture_a0_inputs import read_checked
source=read_checked(Path('build/a0-plan-consumption/candidate/dhd.ko'),dict(bytes=51582680,sha256='8b35af1011201872809d2679fc1f23ed75498ed21019fcc0a4c4160e561a78fd'))

with p.open('xb') as f:
 for off in range(0,len(source),1024*1024):f.write(source[off:off+1024*1024]);f.flush();time.sleep(0.06)
 os.fsync(f.fileno())
def observe(label):
 s=p.stat()
 with p.open('rb') as f:b=f.read(len(source)+1)
 return dict(label=label,bytes=len(b),stat_bytes=s.st_size,sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),matches=b==source,mtime_ns=s.st_mtime_ns,ctime_ns=s.st_ctime_ns,time_ns=time.time_ns())
rows.append(observe('immediate'));print(json.dumps(rows[-1]),flush=True)
time.sleep(4)
rows.append(observe('later'));Path('build/a0-overlap-probe/'+name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(rows[-1]),flush=True)
